subject: general
question: If the vehicle does NOT move due to the brake system, what should be checked first?
solution:
The correct answer is __Parking brake applied**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Parking brake applied__ should be checked first if the vehicle does not move due to the brake system.
 
• Ensuring the parking brake is fully released is crucial before investigating other potential issues.
 
• Other factors like loose inlet fittings, piston diameter, or brake adjusters can be checked if the parking brake is not the issue.
 
• Regular maintenance of the brake system prevents such problems and ensures safe vehicle operation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Brake Adjuster:**

 
 
• The brake adjuster ensures that the brake shoes maintain proper clearance from the drum.
 
• A malfunctioning adjuster can lead to ineffective braking or failure.
 
 
 
• **Loose Inlet Fitting:**
 
 
• Loose fittings can cause fluid leakage, leading to a loss of hydraulic pressure in the brake system.
 
• Proper inspection and tightening of fittings ensure the system's functionality.
 
 
 
• **Piston Diameter:**
 
 
• The piston diameter affects the hydraulic pressure applied to the brakes.
 
• Incorrect piston size can result in insufficient braking force.
